segments.name: Creative platform
segments.description: Licenses photos, footage, music and three-dimensional models and generative AI content, plus data and production services, to brands and businesses.
segments.evidence: The Company is currently organized and operates as one operating and reportable segment on a consolidated basis.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay to license content, and contributors are compensated with royalties based on customer download activity.
revenueModel.evidence: Our platform brings together users and contributors of content by providing readily-searchable content that our customers pay to license and by compensating contributors as their content is licensed.
